metadata.title: Isoperimetry of singular CMC hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We produce the first examples of singular isoperimetric boundaries with non-zero constant mean curvature in Riemannian manifolds. The main technical ingredient is establishing that, for constant mean curvature hypersurfaces containing isolated singularities modelled on strictly stable, strictly minimising regular tangent cones, weak strict stability implies local unique volume-constrained minimisation.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 构造黎曼流形中平均曲率非零且具有奇点的等周边界。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出首批非零 CMC 的奇异等周边界例子，并建立局部唯一极小判据。
analysis.limitations: 奇点模型需严格稳定且严格极小的正则切锥。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 74/100；重点在于给出首批非零 CMC 的奇异等周边界例子，并建立局部唯一极小判据。
